AbsenceReason.description: A reason for an absence. (The schema name `Reason` is taken by the choice of club and team.)

hidden.description: Not offered for new absences; still shown on old ones.

AssignmentInput.description: The player to put on a place.

reason.description: The reason of the absence; `null` when the player is there.

AttendanceOverview.description: The overview of a season on the page "Attendance".

left.description: "Left the team": roles earlier in the season, none today or later.

not_opened.description: Training days before today without a training.

seasons.description:
The seasons to choose from, newest first: those with a role, a weekly training or a
training, the current season and the chosen season.

team.description: A role today or later in the season (on its last day for an earlier season).

trainings.description: The trainings of the season up to today that are not cancelled; 0: no trainings yet.

from.description: "In the team from": the first day of their roles in this season.

players.description: Players of last season to bring into this season ("Add all" sends all of them).

start_time.description: Dutch local start time, for example "13:00"; `null` when it is not known.

from.description: The first day of the new role; the current role ends on the day before.

ChangeView.description: A change from the game as the coordinator last saw it to the game now.

oneOf.description: The game now; `null` for a game no longer in the game list.
The game as last seen; `null` for a new game.

differences.description:
Every difference of a `moved`, `start_time_known`, `home_and_away` or `team_changed`
change; empty for the other kinds.

oneOf.description: The duties of the game, as on "Season" ("has duties"); `null` when it has none.

reason.description: Now, or as last seen when the game is no longer in the schedule.

version.description: Send it back with "seen": a change that a reading updated meanwhile stays.

changes.description: Empty unless a team is chosen for the current season. In the order of the games.

season.description:
The season of the changes (the current season), for the page of a game; `null` without a
chosen team.

ChoiceView.description: A player in the choice of a place.

offers.description:
For each place of the team (in the order of the page): can the player be chosen there
(`team_core::offers`, the checks of the saves).

totals.description: The duties of the player in the game's season, for each kind.

ClashView.description:
A clash with another game: a duty place there ("also Table 13:00") or a game of the team
("plays 14:30").

oneOf.description: The kind of the duty place there; `null`: the player plays that game.

start.description: Dutch local start time of the other game ("13:00"); `null` when not known.

teams.description: The club's own teams in the current season; empty when the season has no games yet.

town.description: `null` when the source has no town for the club.

CountsView.description: How many changes of each kind a reading found, only for games in the schedule.

more_than_proposed.description: The proposal dropped below the filled driver places.

proposal.description: The proposal now: one driver for every 3 players with "plays games" on the date.

proposed.description: The number is the proposal (none was set).

required.description: False: the game no longer needs drivers of the team.

DriversInput.description: The number of drivers; `null`: the proposal.

rows.description:
One row for each player with the role "plays games" in the season or with a duty in it,
also players who left and hidden players; sorted by first name.

seasons.description:
The seasons to choose from, newest first: those with a chosen team, the current season and
the chosen season.

DutyRowView.description: The totals of one player in the season.

EventView.description:
One event: a game or a training (or a training day not opened). Exactly one of `game` and
`training` is set.

week_first_day.description: The Monday and the Sunday of the week.

GameItemView.description: A game of an open item: enough to show it in the list below the item and to open its page.

season.description: The season of the game, for example "2026-2027".

club_teams.description: The pull-down list of the places: the club teams of the season, sorted by name.

past.description: The game is before today: its places can be corrected ("Someone else", "Nobody").

players.description:
The choice of a player for the places of the team: the players with the role "plays
games" on the date (hidden players too), and the players already at the game; sorted by
first name.

season.description: The season of the game, for example "2026-2027".

team.description: The team chosen for the game's season.

HistoryRole.description: A role in a player's history.

correctable.description: Only a role of the current season can be corrected.

season.description: The season of the role, for example "2026-2027".

until.description: The last day; `null` while the role continues.

HoldView.description: Why a reading was held back: `now` games instead of `before`.

LastChoice.description: The choice of an earlier season.

LatestReadings.description: The newest reading and the last good reading of the current club and season.

oneOf.description:
The held-back reading the coordinator can confirm: the newest reading that did not fail,
when it is held back. A failed reading after it does not hide it.

out_of_date_since.description:
The time of the last good reading, when 3 nightly run moments passed without a good
reading: the games may be out of date since then. `null` without a chosen team.

from.description: "Not in the team from": the first day without the team.

removes.description:
The ids of the roles the coordinator confirmed to remove (roles that start on `from` or
later); empty at first.

LeftTeam.description: The answer of "Remove from the team".

Marked.description: The answer of a mark: kept small, so a tap is quick.

absent.description: The training's new number of absences.

MemberView.description: A player in a group of the team page, with a role.

last_day_today.description:
In the team, and today is the last day: the role today ends today, no role follows, and
today is not the last day of the season. The row shows "Last day today".

role.description:
Today's role (or the coming one); in "left", the last role of the season; in
"last_season", the last role of last season.

roles.description: The roles of the season shown (last season's for "last_season").

MissedView.description: A training that a player missed and that counts.

oneOf.description: The first role, if any.

NotOfferedView.description: Why a player cannot be chosen for a place.

NowThere.description: A player who counts as "there" at trainings after a role started or its start moved earlier.

trainings.description: The dates of those trainings, for example "2026-09-01", in order.

OfferView.description: Whether a player can be chosen for one place of the team.

oneOf.description: As the planned player; `null`: can be chosen.

As "Someone else" on a past place with a player; `null`: can be chosen (or no correction
is possible there).

OpenGameView.description: A game of the open item "games with open places", with its open places for each kind.

oneOf.description: A held-back reading of the game list waits for the coordinator.
The game list has not been read well for 3 nights, since the last good reading.
Changes not seen yet.

Home games of the club from today to 4 weeks ahead whose schedule is not entered, in time
order.

Coming games with places of the team without a player, in time order: table and referee
places from today to 4 weeks ahead, driver places from today until the Sunday of next week.
Training days before today that were never opened; `first` is the oldest.
Trainings before today that are neither cancelled nor checked; `first` is the oldest.

OpenItemView.description: One open item. Dates are Dutch dates, for example "2026-10-22".

OutcomeInput.description:
A correction after the game: as planned, done by `player` ("Someone else"), or not done
("Nobody").

PlaceView.description: A duty place of the team.

filled.description: A player is on the place.

oneOf.description: The player on the place, when filled.

PlacesView.description: The duties of a game, in two parts that count on their own.

oneOf.description: The drivers of an away game of the team.

not_entered.description: A home game of the club whose schedule is not entered and whose places count.

open_places.description: The places of the team that count and have no player.

oneOf.description: The 4 places of the referee committee at a home game of the club.

hidden.description: A hidden player is not offered in "Add player" of the team page and not in "Add all".

PlayerDetail.description: One player with the history of all seasons.

has_absences.description: The player has absences, so "Delete player" is not offered.

has_duties.description: The player is on a duty place, or did one, so "Delete player" is not offered.

history.description: All roles of all seasons, newest first.

now_there.description:
After a save of a role: the trainings at which the player now counts as there. Empty
otherwise.

season_first_day.description: The first day of the current season: the earliest date of a corrected role.

season_last_day.description: The last day of the current season: the latest date of a corrected role.

PlayerListItem.description: A player in the list of all players.

oneOf.description: The role today; `null` when the player is not in the team today.

PlayerNameView.description: A player and the name shown ("Anna", or "Anna B." when two players share a first name).

PlayerOnPlaceView.description: The player on a duty place, with the outcome after the game.

oneOf.description: The player who did it instead ("Someone else"), with `outcome` `done_by`.

not_in_team.description:
The player has no role "plays games" on the date of the game ("Not in the team on this
date").

PlayerTotalsView.description: The totals of one player in the season.

trainings.description: "of N trainings": the trainings that count for this player.

PlayersList.description: All players of the club, sorted by first name.

ReadingView.description: One reading of the game list. A failed or held-back reading is a result, not an HTTP error.

oneOf.description: `null` for the first reading, and for a failed or held-back reading.

first_reading.description: The first reading after a choice of club or team: it counts nothing.

games_read.description: The number of games read; `null` for a failed reading.

Reason.description: Why a team must be chosen.

Refusal.description: The body of a refused request: the code, with details for some codes.

date.description: For `role_starts_later`: the start of the player's later role, for example "2026-11-02".

ends.description: For `confirm_removal`: whether the removal also ends a role (else it only removes).

roles.description: For `confirm_removal`: the roles "Remove from the team" would remove, in order of start.

RoleDatesView.description: A role without its id, as "Undo" sends it back.

RoleView.description: A role of a player in the team of a season.

until.description: The last day; `null` while the role continues.

team.description: The source's team number; leave it out only when the season has no games yet.

SavedPlayer.description: A saved player, with the warning that another player has the same name.

ScheduleGame.description: A game of the schedule: the team's games and the home games of other club teams.

home.description: Full team names, with the club name in front.

in_list.description:
False: the game is no longer in the game list; it shows until its change is seen, or
while it keeps duties.

oneOf.description: The duties of the game, when it has any (`team_core::game_places`).

start_time.description: Dutch local start time, for example "13:00"; `null` when it is not known yet.

counts.description: False: a coming game that is gone or is no longer a home game of the club.

of_team.description: The places that name the team chosen for the game's season.

required.description: False: the game is no longer a home game of the club.

oneOf.description: `null`: empty ("—").
The club and team of the season's choice; `null` without a choice (or without a team).

season.description: The season of the events, for example "2026-2027".

season_first_day.description: The first and last day of the season, for "Add training".

seasons.description:
The seasons with trainings, roles, weekly trainings or a choice, and the current and the
chosen season; newest first.

today.description: Dutch date: events of today and later are coming.

open.description: The number of changes not seen yet after this.

oneOf.description: The choice of the newest earlier season, if any (for example last season's team).

Selection.description: The state of the choice. `season` is always the current season.

oneOf.description:
The last training before today that is not cancelled, as an event; `null` when there is
none.

last_games.description:
The games of the last date before today with places of the team, in time order, in the
seasons of the open items (in July and August also the season before).

last_games_season.description: The season of `last_games`, for their pages; `null` when there are none.

next.description:
The games of the team, the home games of other club teams with places of the team, and
the trainings from today until the Sunday of next week, in time order; when there are
none, the first coming one.

open_items.description: What still needs the coordinator, in the order of the start page.

TeamPageView.description: The team of the current season.

candidates.description:
The players "Add player" offers: not hidden and not in the team this season; last season's
team first.

last_season.description:
Players who were in the team until the end of last season, have no role in this season and
are not hidden: "Add all" brings them back. Empty as soon as one player of last season's
team has a role in this season.

left.description: Players with a role earlier in the season and none today or later.

members.description: Players with a role today or later in the season, sorted by first name.

now_there.description:
After "Add player" from the list, "Add to the team" or "Add all": the players who now count
as there at trainings, with those trainings. Empty otherwise.

proposed_from.description: The proposed "In the team from" of "Add player" and "Add all": 1 September of the season.

season_first_day.description: The first day of the season, for example "2026-07-01": the earliest date of a role.

season_last_day.description: The last day of the season, for example "2027-06-30": the latest date of a role.

team_name.description:
The name of the team chosen from the game list for the season, for example "U14-1";
`null` while no team is chosen.

today.description: Today's Dutch date: the proposed date of "Change role" and "Remove from the team".

TrainingDay.description: One date: its training with the players, or nothing yet.

players.description: The players with a role on the date, sorted by first name; empty while not opened.

oneOf.description:
The times "Add training" proposes: the training day's, or a weekly training's on the same
day of the week; `null` when there are none.

reasons.description: All reasons in their order, also the hidden ones (they still show on old absences).

oneOf.description: `null` while no training exists on the date.

TrainingInput.description: "Add training" and "Change": the date and the times of a training.

TrainingRow.description: One row of the list: a training, or a training day that is not opened.

absent.description: The number of absences of players with a role on the date (0 when not opened).

checked.description: The training is checked (always false when not opened).

extra.description: A training on a date that is not a training day.

opened.description: A training exists on the date (also when it is cancelled).

can_check.description: "Checked" is offered: not checked yet, and its date is today or earlier.

checked.description: The coordinator confirmed that the attendance is complete.

UndoRemoval.description:
What "Undo" sends back after "Remove from the team": the date of the removal and the
player's roles of the season from before it.

WeeklyProposalView.description: A weekly training of last season, proposed with a window in the current season.

WeeklyTrainingInput.description: A new or changed weekly training.

WeeklyTrainingView.description: A weekly training: a day of the week with its times, in a window.

from.description: The first day of the window, for example "2026-09-01".

until.description: The last day of the window.

WeeklyTrainings.description: The weekly trainings of the current season, sorted by the start of the window.

proposals.description:
Last season's weekly trainings that ran until its end, one per day of the week that has no
weekly training yet in this season, each with the new proposed window. Saved with "Add".

season_first_day.description: The first day of the season, for example "2026-07-01": the earliest date of a window.

season_last_day.description: The last day of the season, for example "2027-06-30": the latest date of a window.

WindowProposal.description: The proposed window of a weekly training.
